song.title: All my life
song.lyrics:
[V1] .Am C F I've been lost and found . F G Am Been close and far away . Am C F But my confidence is this . F G Am Your love won't stop it's chase
[C1] . F G Am All my life . F C I will lift up Your praises . F C 'Till the end of the ages . Am G F I'll sing of Your love . F G Am Your love won't stop . F C Oh, it runs like a river . F C You have so freely given . Am F Every piece of Your heart
[V2] .Am C F In my love and loss .F G Am I will not forget .Am C F Where my help comes from .F G Am Time and time again
[P1] . F Am F C Ooh ooh ooh ooh . F C Am F Ooh ooh ooh ooh . F Am F C Ooh ooh ooh ooh . F C Am F Ooh ooh ooh ooh
[B1] . F Am Dm7 G Praise the One when the sky falls in . E7/G# Am F C When I'm feeling close to giving in . F Am Dm7 G Praise the One when my fear takes hold . E7/G# Am F When I'm falling short and I lose control . F G Am Dm7 G Oh, praise the One with a deepest love . E7/G# Am F C Who embraced His death to be close to us . F G Am Dm7 G Oh, praise the One with the widest heart . E7/G# Am F C To the end of time You are all I want
song.author: Hillsong Young and Free
